Uforia Dispensary Jersey City is a locally owned cannabis shop at 138 Griffith Street in The Heights neighborhood, serving both walk-in shoppers and same-day delivery customers across Hudson County. Founded by a Jersey City resident, Uforia Dispensary is licensed under New Jersey’s Cannabis Regulatory Commission and combines a curated product selection with a compliant, community-focused operation. This article covers where to find the store, what it sells, how delivery works, and where Uforia Dispensary delivers, along with answers to common questions shoppers ask before ordering.

Uforia Dispensary Jersey City – Location and Hours

Uforia Dispensary is located at 138 Griffith Street, Ground Floor, Jersey City, NJ 07307, in the city’s Heights section. The store can be reached at (201) 420-9333 or (201) 420-WEED. Current in-store hours are Monday through Thursday from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., Friday and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. Street parking is available near Griffith Street, and the store sits a short drive from the 9th St–Congress St Light Rail stop, making Uforia Dispensary easy to reach from Journal Square, Hoboken, and surrounding parts of Jersey City.

What’s on the Menu at Uforia Dispensary

Uforia Dispensary carries flower, pre-rolls, vaporizers, concentrates, edibles, tinctures, topicals, beverages, and accessories, sourced from cultivators and brands that undergo lab testing for potency and safety. Every regulated product sold at Uforia Dispensary carries a certificate of analysis (CoA) that customers can verify using the QR code or URL printed on the packaging. The dispensary’s brands page lists the specific labels carried in-store, which rotate as new products arrive. Shoppers can browse the full menu online, filter by category or brand, and check current pricing before visiting the store or placing a delivery order. The dispensary also runs a loyalty program and posts regular deals, so returning customers can earn rewards on qualifying purchases.

Uforia Dispensary Delivery: How It Works

Uforia Dispensary delivery brings flowers, edibles, vapes, concentrates, and more directly to customers across Jersey City and nearby towns. Orders are placed and prepaid online, since cash is not accepted at the door, through a debit card or ACH payment via AeroPay. Deliveries run daily from 12 p.m. to 8 p.m., and orders of $80 or more qualify for free delivery. New Jersey rules require every delivery customer to be 21 or older and to show valid identification when the order arrives; a signature is also required. Deliveries can only go to a residential address in New Jersey, not to a workplace, parked car, park, or school. Customers receive text updates and can track order status from their account.

Weed Delivery Jersey City – Towns Uforia Serves

Weed delivery in Jersey City is Uforia Dispensary’s fastest coverage area, including The Heights, Journal Square, Bergen-Lafayette, and Greenville. Beyond city limits, Uforia Dispensary delivery also reaches Hoboken, Union City, Weehawken, Bayonne, West New York, North Bergen, Secaucus, Edgewater, and Fort Lee, plus Harrison, Newark, and Kearny across the river. Coverage depends on the delivery address, so customers outside these areas should check availability at checkout before assuming a delivery window is open.

Searching “Weed Delivery Utopia” or “Marijuana Delivery Utopia”? You’re in the Right Place

Because “Uforia” sounds like “euphoria,” it’s a name people commonly mishear or mistype. Searches for weed delivery Utopia or marijuana delivery Utopia are usually attempts to find Uforia Dispensary in Jersey City. If that’s how this page turned up, the store, hours, delivery area, and ordering process described here belong to Uforia Dispensary, not a separate business.

How to Order from Uforia Dispensary Jersey City

Ordering starts on the Uforia Dispensary menu page, where shoppers choose pickup or delivery at checkout. Delivery customers confirm their address and time window, then prepay online before a driver in an unmarked, state-approved vehicle brings the order to the door. Pickup customers can order ahead and collect their items in-store, which is often the faster option for same-day needs. Signing up for the loyalty program before checkout is a simple way to start earning rewards on the first order. Either way, a valid government-issued ID showing proof of age is required, since New Jersey law limits adult-use cannabis sales to customers 21 and older.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where is Uforia Dispensary located?
 Uforia Dispensary is located at 138 Griffith Street on the Ground Floor, in the Heights section of Jersey City, NJ 07307.

Is Uforia Dispensary licensed in New Jersey?
 Yes. Uforia Dispensary operates as a licensed New Jersey cannabis retailer, and every delivery receipt includes the dispensary’s name and license number for verification.

What are Uforia Dispensary’s current hours?
 Uforia Dispensary is open Monday through Thursday from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m., Friday and Saturday from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., and Sunday from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.

Does Uforia Dispensary offer same-day delivery?
 Yes. Orders placed for delivery are typically fulfilled the same day, with drop-offs made daily between 12 p.m. and 8 p.m. across Jersey City and the surrounding delivery area.

Is there a minimum order for free delivery?
 Yes. Orders of $80 or more qualify for free delivery from Uforia Dispensary; smaller orders may carry a delivery fee.

Can someone else accept my Uforia Dispensary delivery?
 Yes, as long as that person is 21 or older and presents valid identification when the order arrives.

Does Uforia Dispensary have a loyalty program? Yes. Customers can sign up for Uforia Dispensary’s loyalty program online and earn rewards on qualifying purchases, whether ordered for pickup or delivery.

Visiting or Ordering from Uforia Dispensary

Whether you’re walking into the Griffith Street location or placing a delivery order from Hoboken, Secaucus, or Journal Square, Uforia Dispensary Jersey City is built around straightforward pricing, lab-verified products, and a compliant ordering process. Check the current menu online before you go, or place a delivery order in advance to line up with the daily 12 p.m. to 8 p.m. delivery window. For hours, directions, or same-day availability, the dispensary’s website and staff remain the most current source.
